# Behold the Falconer

> An independent journal of philosophy and theology: essays and stories on metaphysics and meaning, power and persuasion, media and myth, with aphorisms from the Falconer.

Every article has its own permanent page containing the full text as plain HTML. The home page is a single-page app, so use the links below. Sitemap: https://beholdthefalconer.com/sitemap.xml

## Articles (newest first)

- [On the Synthesis of Love](https://beholdthefalconer.com/on-the-synthesis-of-love) (2026-11-24, metaphysics): Love is a will before it is a feeling: desire ordered by reason, the understanding of another, and a debt that outlives the beloved.
- [What the Watchman Saw](https://beholdthefalconer.com/what-the-watchman-saw) (2026-11-23, power): Pride begins with I, not with God, and every city that has ever burned burned first in the mind of one man who believed his name was worth more than his neighbour's life.
- [The Lamp in the Empty House](https://beholdthefalconer.com/the-lamp-in-the-empty-house) (2026-11-23, metaphysics): Notice how small it is. A lifted head. No words, no touch, no promise.
- [Closing Preamble: Manuscript](https://beholdthefalconer.com/closing-preamble-manuscript) (2026-11-05, metaphysics): I finish reading.
- [Opening Preamble: Manuscript](https://beholdthefalconer.com/opening-preamble-manuscript) (2026-11-05, metaphysics): Reader, imagine a man - he sits before his desk, surrounded by the writings of men who have long since departed this earth, men whose bodies have returned to dust, yet whose thoughts continue to command the attention of the living.
- [Pride Begins With I](https://beholdthefalconer.com/pride-begins-with-i) (2026-11-01, metaphysics): At times it can feel as if my God has left me; at others I am aware of the reality that I left Him.
- [Reflections: What Force Could Redeem Such a Man?](https://beholdthefalconer.com/reflections-what-force-could-redeem) (2026-10-30, metaphysics): He sits, looking upon the ruins of what once was, a commander of men, a conqueror of himself—or so he believed.
- [Three Assorted Poems](https://beholdthefalconer.com/three-assorted-poems) (2026-10-29, media): Reader, imagine a man—his mind a fortress, his heart a captive to the passions he so desperately attempts to govern.
- [Why do men look up to UFC fighters?](https://beholdthefalconer.com/why-do-men-look-up-to-ufc-fighters) (2026-10-29, media): What is it about observing a man knock someone out, just as he predicted, that lights a flame within us?
- [Friends from Orbit?](https://beholdthefalconer.com/friends-from-orbit) (2026-10-29, power): Why do women have the natural ability to spot the group leader?
- [How Can Smart People "Fall For" Religion or the Right?](https://beholdthefalconer.com/how-can-smart-people-fall-for-religion) (2026-10-29, power): The idea that being religious or right-wing is somehow tied to being unintelligent or ignorant is a relatively new development — largely a product of the past 30 years.
- [The Relationship Crisis No One Wants to Talk About](https://beholdthefalconer.com/the-relationship-crisis-no-one-wants) (2026-10-29, power): From the perspective of someone under 25, modern relationships increasingly feel transactional, shallow, and insecure.
- [Relationships in the 2020s: Really a Platonic Form of Beauty?](https://beholdthefalconer.com/relationships-in-the-2020s-really) (2026-10-29, metaphysics): Plato, one of the great saints of Western philosophy, lived almost 2,500 years ago.
- [The Light That Looked Down](https://beholdthefalconer.com/the-light-that-looked-down) (2026-10-24, metaphysics): Before the morning star fell, he came down to look at a man - and saw himself.
- [The Watchman on the Wall](https://beholdthefalconer.com/the-watchman-on-the-wall) (2026-10-07, media): A man guards a city from everything except the one thing he cannot stop watching.
